    ensures 0 <= length <= |s|
    ensures IsPalindrome(Suffix(s, length))
    
method Prefix(s: string, length: int) returns (prefix: string)

    ensures |prefix| == length
    ensures prefix == Substring(s, 0, length)

method Suffix(s: string, length: int) returns (suffix: string)
    requires s != null && 0 <= length <= |s|
    ensures |suffix| == length
    ensures suffix == Substring(s, |s| - length, length)

method Reverse(s: string) returns (reversed: string)
    requires s != null
    ensures |reversed| == |s|
    ensures reversed == Substring(s, |s| - |s|, |s|) // A placeholder for actual reverse logic
